summary.notes: History Matters uses an extremely consistent thumbnail formula: animated/cartoon-style characters with bold white question text overlaid on the left side, and a political map (usually with flag overlays on country silhouettes) on the right. Every thumbnail has an hourglass channel logo in the bottom-left corner. No real human faces appear - all figures are blocky cartoon/animated characters in the channel's signature style. The text is ALWAYS a simplified question version of the video title, not the full title. Icons (flags on maps, prohibition signs, price tags) appear frequently as visual storytelling devices. The overall aesthetic is clean, colorful, and highly recognizable.
